name: escapement
description: Escapement converts available agent capacity plus delegated authority into verified, delivered outcomes while reserving human attention for consequential choices.

interface.shortDescription: The control system for agentic delivery. Delegate outcomes. Get verified delivery.
interface.longDescription: Escapement converts available agent capacity plus delegated authority into verified, delivered outcomes while reserving human attention for consequential choices. Delegate a bounded outcome. Escapement structures the work, allocates isolated execution, challenges the oracle, keeps reversible work moving, and follows the repository's authorized delivery path. Current host limitations stay explicit.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this bounded outcome into verified delivery.
Show me what work is ready in this repo.
Which Escapement capabilities and limits are active in this session?
